name: documenso Envelope Fields (PR #3031)
notes: Upgraded from the banked place-one-field spike to a DISCRIMINATING differential: the shift-click multiselect walk PR #3031's own e2e test drives (runShiftClickMultiSelectFlow, packages/app-tests/e2e/envelope-editor-v2/envelope-fields.spec.ts). Verified against the real tree @97835b8d (merge) vs its single parent @977d0733 (fix: auto select field on drop, #3028): the ONLY changed file is envelope-editor-fields-page-renderer.tsx — the field-group's own 'click' handler reads event.evt.shiftKey and toggles the field into/out of interactiveTransformer.current.nodes() at merge; at parent it unconditionally setSelectedFields([fieldGroup]) (the OLD stage-level shift/ctrl branch is unreachable because e.target on a field click is the Rect child, never hasName('field-group')). Setup (no test-only seed helpers — the real HTTP/exec surface): email-password signup (POST /api/auth/email-password/signup, no CSRF needed) -> a bootstrap team lookup (Team/OrganisationMember/User join; NO REST route exists for this at this SHA — team-router's find-teams openapi meta is commented out in source, so this is the disclosed exec-capture fallback, never the store_tap ground-truth) -> inbucket mailbox+message GETs (origin :9000, the compose graph's own SMTP capture) regex-capturing the 40-hex verification token -> POST verify-email (this ALSO auto-authenticates via onAuthorize, minting the session cookie in the same response — no separate login setup step needed) -> POST /api/v2/envelope/create, a REAL multipart tRPC-openapi route (packages/trpc/server/envelope-router/create-envelope.types.ts declares contentTypes:['multipart/form-data']), authenticatedProcedure + x-team-id header, ONE recipient (required or field placement has nothing to bind fields to) + files[] (blank.pdf, copied from the repo's OWN e2e asset packages/app-tests/assets/example.pdf). front_door lands on the addFields step (intent also names the step-tab selector as a fallback in case the ?step= deep link is not honored). store_tap switched from the original spike's named-scalar count(*) to a row LISTING (observables.fields relation:row-count) so the claim can bind 'equals 1' precisely; settle{quiet_ms,max_ms} rides out the editor's autosave debounce so the tap never reads a mid-flight count. confirm[] is a genuinely fresh login (its own csrf+authorize) that re-GETs the SAME envelope (captured at setup, threaded into the confirm leg as a setup capture — never a session secret) and reads $.fields.length. code_identity: from_tree version_label 2.14.0; documenso/documenso:v2.14.0 is the first shipped release containing #3031.
intent: An author on the Add Fields step (click the tab whose data-testid is envelope-editor-step-addFields if it is not already showing) places three fields on the PDF canvas, selects the first with a plain click, adds the second to the selection with a Shift+click, and removes the selected pair via the floating toolbar's Remove button; exactly one field row remains persisted for the envelope afterward.

exec.query: SELECT t.id, t.url FROM "Team" t JOIN "OrganisationMember" om ON om."organisationId" = t."organisationId" JOIN "User" u ON u.id = om."userId" WHERE u.email = 'catch-shiftclick@documenso.com' LIMIT 1;

front_door.serves: the authenticated document envelope editor's Add Fields step, where the Konva .konva-container canvas renders and Field rows are placed.

queries.fields: SELECT id FROM "Field" ORDER BY id;
